This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their blubbery bodies and flat faces.<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" /> in [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|II}}</ref> a member of this species could be lounging around in the streets of [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Fleshy-Species-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|King 69 Color by Jake Lunt Davies]]
This species was first set to appear during the scenes set at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]] of the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], but these scenes were cut from the finished version of the film, instead first included in its Blu-ray and digital releases. In these scenes, a member of this species attempts to flee from the bathhouse, but is subsequently flung into the air by [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] who come crashing through on [[Fathier]]back.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}} {{C|Blu-ray featurette}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], and it was referred to by the production code "King 69."<ref name="TLJ Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
